issue_request: FHIR-19960 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and requested adding designation-use support for consumer-friendly terms; the issue comments record that consumer and preferredForLanguage should be added to the R5 core designation-use value set.
initial_application: The THO code system work was completed externally, but no core commit mentioning FHIR-19960 was found and the current core designation-use value set still included only the two SNOMED CT concepts.
additional_context: UP-107 and Vocabulary minutes documented the broader designation-use discussion and identified the intended final value set content as existing SNOMED CT concepts plus consumer and preferredForLanguage, while leaving other display/ownership questions unresolved. FHIR-29821 later handled overlapping designation semantics by adding additionalUse and is already represented on the combined branch.
